notes.title: Woah The Game Is Out
notes.notes:
Rectangulong is out now!  I've been working on this game for roughly 37 years and I'm happy to say the final product is exactly what I envisioned all those years ago.  I hope you enjoy it.

I plan on doing some bug fixes and adding even more AWESOME Rectangulong content over time, but my hand is currently purple (Kinda like the fish from Rectangulong, so I will wait for that to stop happening before adding even more AWESOME Rectangulong content.

Please let me know what you think of this video game and if there's anything in particular you'd like to see in future update! (:

Rectangulong
